messages.text:
"Create a 3D survival game in first person. You wake up on a 3x3 plot of land. You are in a game simulation that welcomes you. The game is based on real time. You can only see what's on your land. Around the plot of land and in the distance is a black void. You wake up to a fishing pole and nothing else on the plot. You use this fishing rod to cast out into the void to get chests. You can get food. Water. Gear to use, like a axe for chopping wood you can get a weapon for protection, Materials or land plots to expand your land your standing on. Beyond the void is Monsters. The trial of the game will not allow monsters to come through until the beginning phase has worn off in a week. The game system has given you a backpack that you can p store items if your land does not hold them. The backpack can only hold up to 10 spaces unless you reach lvl 10 or increments of 10. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
